query: SELECT draft_pick, olympic_gold_medals, position FROM player WHERE olympic_gold_medals > 0 AND birth_date != '1943/12/23' AND nba_championships < 2 AND birth_date = '1992/12/17';
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。
